definitions.explanation: A medication used to treat bacterial infections by killing or inhibiting the growth of bacteria. The standard medical term in Japanese for what is commonly called an antibiotic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抗菌薬|こうきんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was prescribed an antibacterial drug by the doctor.

examples.japanese: {抗菌薬|こうきんやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧きること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to finish the full course of antibiotics.

examples.japanese: {抗菌薬|こうきんやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乱用|らんよう}→乱用：15259_ranyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐性菌|たいせいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}む→生む：29531_umu⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧べきだ。
examples.english: Overuse of antibiotics causes antibiotic-resistant bacteria, so they should only be used when necessary.

notes:
Composed of {抗|こう} (anti-, against), ⟦{菌|きん}→菌：02682_kin⟧ (bacteria, germs), and {薬|やく} (medicine, drug). The formal medical term for antibacterial medications.

In everyday Japanese, ⟦{抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}→抗生物質：11089_kouseibusshitsu⟧ (antibiotic, literally "anti-life substance") or the loanword アンチバイオティクス is more commonly used by laypeople, while {抗菌薬|こうきんやく} is preferred in medical and pharmaceutical contexts. Note that {抗菌薬|こうきんやく} specifically targets bacteria, whereas ⟦{抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}→抗生物質：11089_kouseibusshitsu⟧ can sometimes refer more broadly to include antifungals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗菌薬|こうきんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prescribe antibiotics
- {抗菌薬|こうきんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to administer antibiotics
- {抗菌薬|こうきんやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{耐性|たいせい}→耐性：13917_taisei⟧: antibiotic resistance
- ⟦{広域|こういき}→広域：12533_kouiki⟧{抗菌薬|こうきんやく}: broad-spectrum antibiotic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}→抗生物質：11089_kouseibusshitsu⟧: antibiotic — the more commonly known term in everyday language
- ⟦{殺菌剤|さっきんざい}→殺菌剤：22726_sakkinzai⟧: germicide, disinfectant — kills bacteria but used externally, not as a systemic medication
- 抗⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧{薬|やく}: antiviral drug — targets viruses, not bacteria
